body.name: Guarded empirical-cell known-J contribution plug-in
body.construction: On the \(N_m\)-cell absorption-legal support, evaluate the entries of \(\mathfrak m(\widehat p)\) sequentially, stopping before any inverse or division whose required margin is at most \(\kappa\); also require legal absorbing support and \(\widehat\Sigma_{\ell\ell}>\kappa\) for all \(\ell\in\mathcal L\). This event is \(\mathcal E_\kappa\). On \(\mathcal E_\kappa\), set \(\widehat\theta=\Phi(\widehat p)\), \(\widehat G_i=J_\Phi(\widehat p)(e_{O_i}-\widehat p)\), and \(\widehat\Sigma=n^{-1}\sum_i\widehat G_i\widehat G_i^\top\); otherwise return no interval.
